productIdentity: LuHm-OS is an artist-first, artist-controlled creative workstation and production tool for Project Hydra and Pirate Daddy's Film.
mission: Make original artwork, animations, scenes, game worlds and short films easier to create, edit, preview, version and export without displacing the human artist.
priorityOrder: editable source artwork and recoverable masters
reproducible local or remote production tools
Godot scene preview and interactive use
AI copilots, harness, testing, plugins and deployment as supporting infrastructure

surfaceContract.approach: One artist-facing UI may combine native Godot, HTML/CSS/SVG, jQuery widgets, Python3 tools, Blender/GIMP interchange, FFmpeg and optional providers.
surfaceContract.currentImplementationTruth: UI is a candidate shell with asset preview and factory status panel; full paint, animation timeline and end-to-end studio execution are not proved.

canonHierarchy: Professor's exact creative approval and protected original masters
approved manuscript and approval seal for each film
doctrine/yumeCreativePipelineV1.json, doctrine/contentLaneDoctrineV1.json and doctrine/mediaAssetFactoryV1.json (working-lane candidate contracts)
verified assets and per-shot import, provenance and performance evidence
candidate directions, experimental prompts and vendor suggestions

domains.drawing: GIMP/artist master, layer-preserving edit and mask handoff
domains.sprite: pixel/vector source, authentic transparency, atlas grid and >=50px head proofs
domains.animation: keyframe/inbetween/sequence timing, frames and timeline are editable
domains.scene3d: Blender source, GLB or Godot import plus deformation and runtime proof
domains.film: Yume storyboard, silent animatic, FFmpeg assembly, grade/caption/audio later
domains.ui: artist-facing WYSIWYG jQuery/Godot controls, touch/mouse/keyboard accessible
domains.archives: source plus hashes in GitHub; private media bytes in owner-controlled Drive
domains.delivery: render candidate first; public-social publication only after Professor review

productionTemplate.daddyCodex: Belldandy reads Anti-Daddy lore at 401; ending revisits the same archive entry

remoteTruth.github: source and temporary CPU FFmpeg build jobs, not durable artwork
remoteTruth.codespaces: configurable cloud studio, running existence requires proof
remoteTruth.render: API sidecar and harness, not automatically a remote media render farm
remoteTruth.drive: durable binary vault; current link-readable media hierarchy not private until repaired

gates.namingPolicy: new transport filenames and branch slugs use lowercase kebab-case; existing internal machine identities preserved until explicit migration
